message: ci: run tests on GitHub Actions

feat(report)!: sort categories by amount instead of name

BREAKING CHANGE: the report now lists the largest categories first.
Scripts that relied on alphabetical order must sort the output.

feat(budget): warn when a category exceeds its monthly budget

Limits are read from budgets.toml (see budgets.example.toml). On
Python < 3.11 this needs tomli, which is now a dependency.
docs(readme): add installation and usage instructions
refactor(storage): extract CSV row conversion into helper functions
feat(cli): add --category filter to the list command

fix(report): only count expenses from the requested year

monthly_totals compared only the month, so the report for 2026-03
also included March expenses from earlier years.
test(storage): cover loading and saving expenses
feat(report): add monthly totals by category
feat(cli): add commands to record and list expenses
feat(storage): store expenses in a CSV file
